many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

For sparse, interrupted outlines, don't fill every gap between aligned markers by default: first check whether the markers trace an enclosing frame; if so, test filling only missing border cells and leave the interior unchanged. Implement or fix `transform(grid)` and run it against every pair received; require exact input-output matches before submitting. When entering a grid for local testing, assert its row count and every row width against the stated dimensions before calling the transform; fix transcription errors rather than submitting a partial or malformed grid.
3. Run the verified transform on the test input and copy its returned grid exactly into the required submit action; do not manually adjust cells. Keep the required action JSON as the final line.
4. After verdict, save the transform that reproduces all received pairs at `programs/<task id>.py`, replacing the old version, then finish only when the instance is over.
